observations.content: Local main had merges a706b95b (Merge upstream v0.16.0, conflicts resolved, touches .github/workflows/release.yml) and fe60750f (Merge upstream main 3ba16407, clean); check-guards, test-sync.sh, launcher cargo test (338 passed) and check-api all passed.
User stated they already pushed main to origin themselves; confirmed origin/main at fe60750f, no v0.16.0 tag on fork yet. User asked what to do next to make a release.

Assistant explained release steps: run Actions > Upstream sync (workflow_dispatch, or daily cron 05:17 UTC) which tags v0.16.0 at a706b95b via SYNC_TOKEN and triggers release.yml; alternative is git push origin a706b95b:refs/tags/v0.16.0; release.yml drafts, builds 4 platforms, attests, publishes only if all package jobs pass; immutable releases must be enabled in Settings; close issue #1 manually (workflow never closes issues). windows-package job most likely to fail since new Recompia.exe/dual-archive (Recompia-* and PokopiaRecomp-*) layout untested.

User asked where the second launcher game 'Zonith' came from. Answer: hardcoded from upstream commit cf0147de (2026-11-18 multi-game redesign) plus fixes 11-19; rail row in launcher/src/games.js PRODUCTS/GAMES; download URL constant RELEASES_URL in launcher/src-tauri/src/zonith.rs = https://api.github.com/repos/Dittobyte/Zonith/releases?per_page=20 (repo now public, returns 200). Downloads TotK-Setup-*-windows.zip or .AppImage.

Assistant flagged Zonith bypasses fork trust model: only checks GitHub-listed sha256 digest (zonith::latest, Pinned download in zonith_cmds.rs:230 run_job), no attestation or immutability check, and check-guards.sh only covers releases.rs, update.rs, attest.rs. Suggested adding a guard for new external download URLs.

User requested Zonith download path only accept immutable attested releases, and said they will then change the upstream URL to point at their fork, asking where that is (answer: RELEASES_URL in launcher/src-tauri/src/zonith.rs line 10).

Investigation for Zonith attestation: attest.rs has pub verify_release(agent, repo, tag, asset, sha256) using RELEASE_WORKFLOW .github/workflows/release.yml and RELEASE_BRANCHES main/testing, and private verify_built(agent, repo, workflow, branches, tag, asset, sha256). zonith_cmds.rs fetch() at line 76-86 uses RELEASES_URL (testhook override in debug), start_download line 192, run_job line 226. Untracked .memory/ dir exists in repo; local main equals origin/main.
